description: This Java source file defines the MediaFormatBuilder class, which provides static methods for constructing and configuring MediaFormat objects, including setting codec-specific data and parsing Opus configuration data.

classes.name: MediaFormatBuilder
classes.description: Utility class for building and configuring MediaFormat objects, including setting codec-specific data and parsing Opus configuration data.

methods.name: setCodecSpecificData
methods.description: Sets codec-specific data in a MediaFormat object using provided byte arrays, assigning keys 'csd-0', 'csd-1', etc.

methods.name: createAudioFormat
methods.description: Creates and returns a MediaFormat object for audio with specified MIME type, sample rate, channel count, codec-specific data, and optional ADTS header flag.

methods.name: starboardParseOpusConfigurationData
methods.description: Parses Opus configuration data to extract pre-skip and pre-roll timing information, returning an array of byte arrays including configuration data and timing info.
